newsitem.title: USA: Uruguay seeking to buy one mln bbls crude for Oct.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay seeking to buy one mln bbls crude for Oct.

text.p: Uruguay's state oil refiner ANCAP is seeking to buy one million barrels of crude oil for Oct 1-10 arrival, a trade source said Friday.
Bids are due Aug 20, with an award due on Aug 21.
The tender was initially supposed to be issued on Aug 8, but the company postponed it to accommodate a scheduled maintenance of the topping unit of the 34,600-barrel-per-day (bpd) La Teja refinery.
The unit was shut down on Aug 10 and is expected to resume operations around Aug 20.
ANCAP is seeking crude with an American Petroleum Institute (API) gravity range of 26-45 degrees and a sulfur content of 0.5 percent to 1.8 percent.
In its last purchase tender, ANCAP bought one million barrels of Iranian Heavy crude from Brazil's state oil company Petrobras for delivery in the second half of August.
